title: An item's state.json
description: The item's status, run state and counters, and the run state's `host`, `next`, `held` and `session`, each allowed only with its run state (`dependentSchemas`) (graphs.md, "Item data outside the document", D-615; core.md, "Run state", D-3; steps.md, "Counting"). F-137 D8 owns it; the record schema refers to its properties. A later feature that stores another fact in state.json adds its property here, in its own story. Whether `status` names a status of the item's type is the flow set's check (F-139).

run.description: The run state as stored: `idle`, `active: <box>`, `waiting: <box>`, `gated: <to status>` or `gated before: <box>` (D-3). `interrupted` is found when bl reads, never stored.

changes.description: Repo name to its change on the forge, as `change.open` records it, for example `{ number, url }`; a stage's command reads its repo's entry as `{{change.*}}` (steps.md, "Command variables", D-84; F-140 D4).

host.description: With `active: <box>` only: the host name of the process that runs the box (D-4, F-139 Decision A2).

next.description: With `idle` only: the box path where the next invocation starts; with no `next`, the item has no next box (D-3, F-139 Decision A2).

box.description: The node of the flat graph.

outcome.description: The outcome whose arrow holds the transition.

held.description: With `gated: <to status>` only: the arrow that holds the transition, by reference to the flow (D-4, F-139 Decision A2).

box.description: The box whose agent step runs the session.

profile.description: The profile of `config/agents.yaml` that runs it.

session.description: With `active: <box>` only: the agent session of the box that runs, so that a resumed invocation at that box continues it (D-417, F-141 D8). Its `box` is the box of `active: <box>`, which `checkState` checks, because a schema cannot compare two fields.

Counter.description: A counter of the `increment` step; a counter with no `value` reads 0. Each number is at most 2^53 - 1 (`Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`), the largest integer that `bl` adds 1 to exactly.
